newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-KOCAELISPOR WIN SURPRISE PLACE IN CUP WINNERS' CUP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-KOCAELISPOR WIN SURPRISE PLACE IN CUP WINNERS' CUP.

text.p: Kocaelispor upset Trabzonspor 1-0 in the second leg of the Turkish Cup on Wednesday to book a place in next year's Cup Winners' Cup.
Kocaelispor, having held on for a 1-1 draw in the first leg away at Trabzon, clinched a late winner through Nuri Colak in a scrappy tussle which saw few chances fall to either side.

With two minutes to go and Trabzon surging forward, Colak found himself unmarked on the left flank and, after hesitating, struck a perfect shot across the goalkeeper and into the top right-hand corner of the net from 10 metres out.
"When I got the ball I knew I was going to score... I want everyone to know that we will try to represent Turkey in the best possible way in Europe next year," Colak said.
